D/ IMP CAES ANTONIN[...] ; R/ MARS VICTOR

Roman denarius of Elagabalus. MARS VICTOR reverse type. Mint of Rome. Issued AD 218 - 222. RIC Vol. IV, pt. II, p. 36, no. 121. Obverse description: laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP CAES ANTONIN[...]. Reverse description: Mars advancing right. Reverse inscription: MARS VICTOR
